barriers.barrier: 0x0043A550 semantics: what transformation it applies to the table DWORD to produce the 0x0072F580 ECX argument (key object builder? handle resolver?).
barriers.required_evidence: admitted read of body 0x0043A550 (not in current admission); out-of-window VA recorded in HANDOFF.
barriers.impact_on_building_placement: closes the exact key type carried into the templates.vfs registry lookup; needed before any claim about WHAT the tables' DWORDs represent (resource IDs, handles, indices).

barriers.barrier: 0x0072F580 internal walk mechanics: the RB-tree traversal itself (bridge standing attributes it as the templates.vfs keyed lookup; this package only confirms the CALL).
barriers.required_evidence: admitted read of 0x0072F580 (large body; needs its own admission); alternatively keep as cited standing.
barriers.impact: low for C1 closure (attribution already cited); high only if the bridge attribution is challenged.

barriers.barrier: 0x0070ED80: identity of the returned object (word fields at +0x0C/+0x0E), meaning of args 0x1F/0x20, and whether ECX=this is consumed.
barriers.impact: defines what selects the worklist element category (the column index source).

barriers.barrier: 0x006B22D0: row-index semantics; whether the dead first call per body is a stateful cursor advance (iterator hypothesis P12-H1, UNVERIFIED).
barriers.impact: determines whether producer calls iterate (cursor) or re-read (pure); shapes any worklist-ordering model.

barriers.barrier: Table contents at 0xA857C8/0xA85804 are NOT in the saved text corpus; recovering the DWORD values would require EXE/.data access = FORBIDDEN in this campaign. Data barrier, not an admission gap.
barriers.required_evidence: none obtainable under campaign rules; the barrier is permanent for saved-only work unless a prior saved export elsewhere in the catalog documents .data around 0xA85xxx (parent may check the catalog; P12 did not open any file beyond the pinned source and cited reports).
barriers.impact: the actual key values feeding the registry lookups stay unknown; only the indexing arithmetic is established.

barriers.barrier: 0xBA5800 sentinel semantics (returned by body 1 fail arm).
barriers.required_evidence: would require payload dereference (FORBIDDEN) or a saved export documenting the object at 0xBA5800.

barriers.barrier: Body 2 fail arm (0x006C2832+) and terminal rows (0x006C2830/0x006C2831) are out-of-window; body 2's fail return value is NOT claimed.
barriers.required_evidence: parent admission of VA 0x006C2830-0x006C2839 (10-byte window would cover POP ESI/RET + fail arm).
barriers.impact: completes body 2's return contract (success-path return already STRONGLY_SUPPORTED by stack forcing).

barriers.barrier: Sibling producer family (navigation over-display showed same-shape bodies at 0x006C2700, 0x006C2750, 0x006C2840, 0x006C2870, and further entries >=0x006C28A0) - NOT read, NOT claimed; recorded as VAs only.
barriers.required_evidence: parent admission per body if the family's other tables/columns matter.
barriers.impact: if the family shares the 0x0043A550->0x0072F580 tail (plausible, UNVERIFIED), the [EDI+0x8] object exposes a whole getter family over adjacent global tables; relevant to mapping which resource categories feed worklists.

barriers.barrier: P11's remaining out-of-window targets still unadmitted and unread by P12: 0x006B4120 (helper), 0x006B6CB9+ (stage-B success exit), 0x006B6C9F+ (pump continuation), enclosing function head (<0x006B6C1B).
barriers.required_evidence: parent admissions; unchanged from P11 HANDOFF.
barriers.impact: as in P11 (enclosing loop structure, pump consumer).
